skill.name: softsync-documents
skill.description: Design PDF templates such as invoices, quotes and contracts, try them on a record, and make the finished PDF. Use when the user wants a new document layout, to change one, or a PDF for a record.
skill.summary: Create and preview record-based PDF templates, generate documents, and coordinate approved signature requests in SoftSync.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.user_title: Create SoftSync PDFs and Coordinate Signatures
content.value_statement: Preparing consistent documents and tracking signatures takes repeated manual work. This skill guides SoftSync template creation, record-based PDF generation, and signature requests with user approval.
actual_capabilities: List and inspect document templates, including layouts, paper settings, and file names.
Create and update templates with record-field placeholders, and delete templates while retaining previously generated PDFs.
Preview a saved template or draft layout against one record without adding the preview to that record.
Generate a finished PDF and list it on its source record.
List record files, inspect signature roles, and check signing progress.
Prepare approved signature emails with exact role names, parallel or sequential signing steps, and copy recipients.
limitations: Requires access to the documented SoftSync tools; the skill does not include their implementations or connection setup.
Template changes require editor rights in the template group.
Updating layout or page settings replaces the entire supplied component, so partial edits require reading existing values first.
Signature requests email real people and must wait for explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare invoice PDFs
use_cases.description: Create an invoice template, preview it against an invoice record, and generate the requested PDF on that record.

use_cases.title: Revise quote layouts
use_cases.description: Inspect an existing quote template, update the requested layout details, and review a preview before generating the customer document.

use_cases.title: Coordinate contract signatures
use_cases.description: Inspect PDF signature roles, propose signer order, obtain approval, and track completion of the signature request.

prompt_templates.title: Find a template
prompt_templates.prompt: List the available document templates and show the layout, paper settings, and file name for [template].

prompt_templates.title: Preview a record
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview [template] using [record]. Show the PDF without generating a document on the record.

prompt_templates.title: Update a document layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [template], then apply [layout changes] while preserving other settings. Save the requested changes and preview them using [record].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise a template without losing existing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an ordered signature workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [record PDF] and match [people] to its exact signature roles. Propose parallel or sequential steps and copy recipients. Wait for approval before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: coordinate multiple signers and recipients.

output_examples.input: Preview the invoice template using my selected invoice record without adding a document to the record.
output: The template was filled using the selected invoice record.
The preview PDF is ready for review.
No generated document was added to the record.

output_examples.input: Prepare this contract for customer signing followed by our countersignature, and copy our legal reviewer.
output: Step 1: the customer signs in the matching customer role.
Step 2: our representative signs in the matching countersignature role.
Copy recipient: the legal reviewer receives the signed PDF.
Approve this document, recipient list, and signing order before any emails are sent.

best_practices: Read the current template before replacing its layout or page settings.
Preview saved changes against a representative record and inspect the resulting PDF.
Confirm the document, exact signature roles, recipients, and signing order before approving signature emails.
anti_patterns: Sending only a layout fragment when the update replaces the entire layout.
Treating a preview as a generated PDF already listed on the record.
Sending signature emails before receiving explicit approval for the document, recipients, and signing order.

faq.question: Which document types does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It describes record-based PDF templates, with invoices, quotes, and contracts as examples.

faq.question: Does saving a template create a PDF?
faq.answer: No. Saving stores the template. Preview renders a temporary PDF, while generate creates a finished PDF listed on the record.

faq.question: What permissions are needed to change templates?
faq.answer: You need editor rights in the group containing the template.

faq.question: What happens when I delete a template?
faq.answer: The template is removed, but PDFs already generated from it are kept.

faq.question: Can multiple people sign at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. Signers assigned the same step sign in parallel. Higher steps wait for lower steps to complete.

faq.question: Will signature requests send immediately?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires showing the document, signers, and signing order, then waiting for explicit user approval before emailing recipients.
